steps.note: 雪球首页落地（这次导航就是 cookie 预热——引擎收到 acw_tc 等会话 cookie 存进 jar，后续页内 fetch 才有票）。SPA 首页重，等 complete 就够，不需要等任何业务 selector

args.script: (async () => { const r = await fetch('https://stock.xueqiu.com/v5/stock/quote.json?symbol=' + encodeURIComponent('{{symbol}}') + '&extend=detail', { credentials: 'include' }); const j = await r.json(); const q = (j.data || {}).quote || {}; if (!q.symbol) throw new Error('xueqiu quote miss — http=' + r.status + ' code=' + j.code + ' raw=' + JSON.stringify(j).slice(0, 200)); return { http: r.status, symbol: q.symbol, name: q.name, current: q.current, percent: q.percent, chg: q.chg, high: q.high, low: q.low, open: q.open, last_close: q.last_close, volume: q.volume, amount: q.amount, market_capital: q.market_capital, pe_ttm: q.pe_ttm, pb: q.pb, timestamp: q.timestamp }; })()

steps.note: 页内 fetch 而不是 http 步：雪球的行情接口要会话 cookie，flow http 步是每步新建的无 cookie 裸客户端带不了。三踩：(1) 不能带任何自定义 header——加 Referer 就变非 simple request，CORS preflight 直接 400；(2) stock.xueqiu.com 与页面跨子域但对方给了 CORS 面，裸 GET + credentials:include 是 simple request 不预检，一次过；(3) eval 默认 5s 预算不够（首跳含 DNS/TLS 4.8s+），必须传 timeout_ms
